Reason for Mistake: The Planner misclassified the genre after the Rings (2017) page was opened. Despite the WebSurfer displaying Wikipedia’s description as an “American supernatural horror film,” the Planner summarized it as an “American psychological thriller,” omitting “supernatural” and “horror” and thus providing the wrong genre.
